SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.slug AS categorySlug, c.name AS categoryName, p.name AS name, p.summary AS summary, p.status AS status, p.display_price AS displayPrice, p.shipping_price AS shippingPrice, (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'GALLERY' ORDER BY pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnailUrl, COALESCE(prs.avg_rating, 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(prs.review_count, 0) AS reviewCount FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN product_review_stats prs ON prs.product_id = p.product_id
p.is_deleted = false AND p.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT', 'DISCONTINUED')
AND c.slug = #{categorySlug}
ORDER BY p.product_id DESC

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.slug AS categorySlug, c.name AS categoryName, p.name AS name, p.summary AS summary, p.status AS status, p.display_price AS displayPrice, p.shipping_price AS shippingPrice, (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'GALLERY' ORDER BY pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnailUrl, COALESCE(prs.avg_rating, 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(prs.review_count, 0) AS reviewCount FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN product_review_stats prs ON prs.product_id = p.product_id
p.is_deleted = false
AND c.slug = #{categorySlug}
ORDER BY p.product_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS name, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, p.summary AS summary, p.detail_content AS detailContent, p.status AS status, p.display_price AS displayPrice, p.shipping_price AS shippingPrice, (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'GALLERY' ORDER BY pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnailUrl, COALESCE(prs.avg_rating, 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(prs.review_count, 0) AS reviewCount FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN product_review_stats prs ON prs.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.is_deleted = false

SELECT v.product_variant_id AS productVariantId, v.product_id AS productId, v.option_label AS optionLabel, v.price AS price, v.status AS status, v.sort_order AS sortOrder, (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_variant_id = v.product_variant_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' LIMIT 1) AS thumbnailUrl FROM product_variant v WHERE v.product_variant_id = #{productVariantId} AND v.is_deleted = false
SELECT url FROM product_image WHERE product_variant_id = #{productVariantId} AND image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' LIMIT 1

SELECT v.product_variant_id AS productVariantId, v.product_id AS productId, v.option_label AS optionLabel, v.price AS price, v.status AS status, v.sort_order AS sortOrder, (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_variant_id = v.product_variant_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' LIMIT 1) AS thumbnailUrl FROM product_variant v WHERE v.product_id = #{productId} AND v.is_deleted = false ORDER BY v.sort_order, v.product_variant_id

SELECT product_image_id AS productImageId, product_id AS productId, product_variant_id AS productVariantId, image_type AS imageType, url AS url, alt_text AS altText, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM product_image WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND product_variant_id IS NULL ORDER BY image_type, sort_order

SELECT a.product_addon_id AS productAddonId, a.name AS name, a.price AS price FROM product_addon a JOIN product_addon_map m ON m.product_addon_id = a.product_addon_id AND m.product_id = #{productId} WHERE a.is_deleted = false ORDER BY a.product_addon_id
SELECT a.product_addon_id AS productAddonId, a.name AS name, a.price AS price FROM product_addon a WHERE a.is_deleted = false ORDER BY a.product_addon_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_addon (name, price, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO product_variant (product_id, option_label, price, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{productId}, #{optionLabel}, #{price}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ON_SALE'), COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE product_variant SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE product_variant_id = #{productVariantId}
mapper.select: SELECT product_variant_id FROM product_variant WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = false

mapper.select: SELECT url FROM product_image WHERE product_id = #{productId}

SELECT i.inquiry_id, i.product_id, CASE WHEN i.is_secret = 'Y' AND (#{role} IS NULL OR #{role} != 'ADMIN') AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR i.created_by != #{userId}) THEN '' ELSE i.title END AS title, CASE WHEN i.is_secret = 'Y' AND (#{role} IS NULL OR #{role} != 'ADMIN') AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR i.created_by != #{userId}) THEN '' ELSE i.content END AS content, i.is_secret, i.is_answered, i.created_at, i.created_by, u.username, u.email, CASE WHEN i.is_secret = 'N' THEN TRUE WHEN #{role} = 'ADMIN' THEN TRUE WHEN #{userId} IS NOT NULL AND i.created_by = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS can_view, CASE WHEN i.is_secret = 'Y' AND (#{role} IS NULL OR #{role} != 'ADMIN') AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR i.created_by != #{userId}) THEN '' ELSE a.title END AS answer_title, CASE WHEN i.is_secret = 'Y' AND (#{role} IS NULL OR #{role} != 'ADMIN') AND (#{userId} IS NULL OR i.created_by != #{userId}) THEN '' ELSE a.content END AS answer_content, a.created_at AS answer_created_at FROM inquiry i LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = i.created_by LEFT JOIN inquiry a ON a.upper_inquiry_id = i.inquiry_id
i.product_id = #{productId} AND i.upper_inquiry_id is null
AND i.is_secret = 'N'
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
